topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: So, you're just up and leaving, huh? Just like that, after all these years? You expect me to be okay with packing your stuff, helping you load the truck, and then waving goodbye like it’s no big deal? I can’t even guess what your hurry is. A new start sounds glamorous, doesn’t it? But what about the start we had here? The one we built together? I get that you need to follow your dreams, but it feels like a punch in the gut, knowing you’re miles away from everything—and everyone—you’ve ever known. Guess I’ll start getting used to the idea, or maybe I won’t.
